# HGPRO

> HGPRO is the web design and development studio of Hanoch Gotovski (חנוך גוטובסקי), based in Israel. It designs and builds custom websites from scratch, with no templates, and produces AI commercials. Sites are fast, accessible, bilingual (Hebrew/English) and built to bring leads. Fixed prices, live within two weeks.

## Services and prices (ILS, VAT-exempt business)
- Website packages: Presence (landing page) from 4,900; Business (full site, up to 8 pages, CMS, SEO) from 8,900; Signature (flagship site with 3D, store or custom system, two languages) from 19,900.
- Add-ons: e-commerce platform from 3,900; secure payments from 1,200; automated invoicing from 500; quote engine from 1,600; online booking from 2,600; client & learning portal from 5,900; CRM & integrations from 1,400; business dashboard from 4,900; AI commercial production from 3,900; AI customer concierge from 2,900; AI visual studio from 1,500; 3D product showcase from 500; interactive simulation from 2,900; SEO from 2,400; tracking & campaigns from 1,400; content hub & blog from 1,200; email automation from 1,200; brand identity from 600; marketing copywriting from 1,900; multilingual site from 300; Wix/WordPress migration from 400.
- Care plans: 290 or 890 per month.
